svg.title: Face flow: along the guide and following the outline, on a face with fingers
svg.text: A flat face with two fingers, 3 mm ball, 0.8 mm stepover, Stay down between passes on
Drawn from the program's own output (test face of decision 0xxz). Each colour is one run: what is cut from one plunge to the next lift.
the passes break at every notch; a dot is each plunge
the outline, then offsets inwards at the stepover, joined by steps
Follow the outline: the first pass is the face's own outline, round the fingers and their tips; each next pass is the stepover inside the last, measured on the face,
and the tool steps across to it with A linear where the step is clear. Where offsets from both sides of a finger meet, the last pass lies along its middle.
Automatic takes this pattern because the passes along the guide would leave the face (they run across the notches); a plain face keeps its passes along the guide.
